hero.lede: Prepare for university admission tests with original practice questions, worked explanations and timed practice. Find what needs work and build your next study session.

directory.title: Choose your <accent>exam.</accent>

bocconi.label: Bocconi admission test preparation
bocconi.note: The undergraduate and Law tests: practice questions, a free test and the official rules.

directory.allExams: Every exam, with format and practice availability

journey.lede: Every session feeds the next. What you get wrong is kept, explained and brought back, so practice time goes where it is needed.

start.title: Pick a starting point
start.body: Take a short diagnostic across the exam’s own topics where one is open, or go straight to the topic you want.

practise.title: Practise with explanations
practise.body: Check each answer when you are ready: the worked solution follows, with a note on why each wrong option fails.

struggled.title: See where you struggled
struggled.body: Accuracy by topic, always shown with the number of questions it rests on.

review.title: Review, then go again
review.body: Missed questions wait in your mistake notebook and come back for another look. Retrying never changes the original session’s result.

formats.title: What you can practise <accent>today.</accent>
formats.lede: A format opens only when the exam’s rules are verified and the reviewed bank can fill it without repeating a question. These counts come from the live bank.
formats.reviewedQuestions: {count, plural, one {# reviewed question} other {# reviewed questions}}
formats.footnote: Counts as of {date}. Essay tasks are not listed: we do not author or score essays. Every format shows its limits again on the practice screen, before you start.
formats.allFormats: Every format, and what each still needs

detail.rulesNotVerified: The rules it needs are not verified
detail.timedOpenWithRest: {names}; {rest, plural, one {# more needs questions} other {# more need questions}}

trust.eyebrow: Why you can check our work
trust.title: Built to be <accent>checked.</accent>

original.title: Original questions
original.body: Drafted with AI assistance for this bank. Before publication a separate AI reviewer solved each one without the answer key, and code compared the two answers. No per-question human review is recorded yet.

explanations.title: Worked explanations
explanations.body: Each answer is explained step by step, and each wrong option carries its own note on why it fails.

sources.title: Sources and verification dates
sources.body: Format, timing and scoring facts cite the test maker’s own pages, with the date they were last checked.
sources.example: For example, the <link>SAT format guide</link> cites {host}, checked {date}.

trust.wontDo: What we won’t do: invent a scaled score, report percentiles, or predict admission.

final.title: Your next step is <accent>one question</accent> away.

facts.reviewedQuestions: {count, plural, one {# reviewed question} other {# reviewed questions}}
facts.reviewedQuestionsSplit: {count, plural, one {# reviewed question} other {# reviewed questions}} ({breakdown})
facts.timedSections: {count, plural, one {# timed section} other {# timed sections}}

sample.legend: Which exam are you preparing for?
sample.heading: Sample question
sample.loadFailed: We couldn’t load the {exam} sample. Check your connection and try again.
sample.none: No sample question is available for the {exam} right now.
sample.rightDetail: {answer} is the answer. Here is the full working.
sample.wrongDetail: You chose {chosen}. The answer is {answer}. Here is why.
sample.rationaleNote: Written for this option in advance: a common route to it, not a claim about how you reasoned.
sample.otherOptions: A note on every other option
sample.footer: One question can’t show how ready you are. It shows how every answer is explained.

learningNotice.labelsSaved: Labels saved. They are private and do not change your result.
learningNotice.nothingToRetry: There was nothing to retry: those questions are under review, or they were not ones you missed.
learningNotice.rateLimited: Too many sessions were started in a short time. Try again in a few minutes.
learningNotice.insufficientContent: Not enough new questions are left for that session. The options on this page show what is available now.
learningNotice.notAMistake: Only a question you got wrong or left blank can be labelled.
learningNotice.notFound: That question is not in one of your finished sessions.

support.title: When you need help, <accent>a person answers.</accent>
support.body: In the age of AI support, talking to a real person has become a luxury. At UniExamer it is simply how support works: someone on our team reads every message and writes the reply, within {days, plural, one {one business day} other {# business days}}.
support.what: Ask about your account, a payment, a question you think is wrong, or how to prepare for your exam. No chatbot stands between you and us.

replyTime.label: First reply
replyTime.value: Within {days, plural, one {one business day} other {# business days}}

who.label: Who answers
who.value: A person on the UniExamer team, never a bot

support.questionReports: Found a mistake in a specific question? <link>Report it</link> from the question, so we see exactly the version you saw.
